configurePresets.name: _base
configurePresets.description: Shared Ninja + clang-cl settings. Embedded debug info (/Z7 via CMP0141=NEW) keeps debug objects content-cacheable (separate /Zi PDBs are not). Cross-worktree object reuse (verified 2026-07-12, byte-identical objects): CCACHE_BASEDIR relativizes worktree paths in the hash, CCACHE_NOHASHDIR drops the build cwd, CCACHE_IGNOREOPTIONS drops the per-worktree -ffile-prefix-map VALUE (the flag itself still scrubs paths from the object), CCACHE_SLOPPINESS makes PCH TUs cacheable. VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR shares one vcpkg payload (was 1.1 GB copied per worktree). The launcher (ccache, sccache fallback) is auto-detected by the root CMakeLists.

configurePresets.name: ninja
configurePresets.description: Default build. Identical to `dev` (both inherit everything from _base, incl. shared deps via ATX_DEPS_DIR and the ccache keys); kept as a separate name for muscle memory. Run from a VS Developer shell or the VSCode CMake Tools extension so the MSVC environment is present.

configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.displayName: dev: canonical fast-iterate preset (ccache + shared deps + PCH)
configurePresets.description: The default preset for agents and worktrees, by construction rather than by convention: scripts/atx-build.ps1 declares its -Preset parameter with a default of dev, and scripts/new-worktree.ps1 targets it too. Compiler cache + shared FetchContent deps + shared vcpkg dir all come from _base/CMakeLists auto-detection. Unity stays OFF: stable per-TU objects are what the ccache cross-worktree cache keys on, and unity batches (16 test files merged per TU) were the slowest TUs in the ninja log. Opt back in with -DATX_UNITY_BUILD=ON for a cache-less cold build — a manual escape hatch: the repository's only CI workflow (.github/workflows/atx-db.yml) is path-filtered to atx-db/** and never builds the C++ tree, so no job does this for you.

configurePresets.name: equity-rel
configurePresets.displayName: equity-rel: optimised equity pipeline binary for measurement sweeps (no AVX2, no IPO)
configurePresets.description: Release equity tree in build-equity-rel/. P9 S1 (DS-1): the Release IC exe atx-equity-strategy-ic (build preset equity-rel-ic, or scripts/research-build.ps1 -Preset equity-rel -Targets atx-equity-strategy-ic); its vm_identity / ic_identity carry the Release build token, so it never shares a candidate-cache or IC-result entry with the Debug tree. FETCHCONTENT_BASE_DIR is per-worktree (deps/equity-rel, gitignored) like equity-bench and equity-hygiene: a Release tree sharing the machine-wide C:/atx-cache/deps spdlog-build with the Debug trees races on _ITERATOR_DEBUG_LEVEL (rel-avx2, scripts/atx-build.ps1 DEPS ISOLATION). equity-asan and equity-bench set their own.

configurePresets.name: equity-asan
configurePresets.displayName: equity-asan: scoped native sector-column bounds gate
configurePresets.description: W0-R04 sanitizer reversal: actual factor_model.cpp and sector-column fixtures are instrumented by a dedicated target. LLVM Windows ASan requires Release CRT; /Od retains simple diagnostic code generation. Dependencies remain uninstrumented. This is a bounded memory-access gate, not whole-engine sanitizer qualification.

configurePresets.name: equity-hygiene
configurePresets.description: Same Debug compiler/CRT/warnings as equity-dev, with PCH disabled in a separate tree. Run scoped check commands here without invalidating the warm equity-dev PCH and consumer objects.

configurePresets.name: equity-bench
configurePresets.displayName: equity-bench: equity-rel + benchmarks + every test group (bench measurement tree)
configurePresets.description: Release equity tree with ATX_BUILD_BENCH=ON (atx-engine-bench, incl. the lane-6 optimizer_production_bench) and ATX_TEST_GROUPS=all, in its own build-equity-bench/ so it never disturbs the Debug build-equity/ lane trees or build-equity-rel/. FETCHCONTENT_BASE_DIR is per-worktree (deps/equity-bench, gitignored): a Release tree sharing the machine-wide C:/atx-cache/deps spdlog-build with the Debug lane trees races on _ITERATOR_DEBUG_LEVEL (see rel-avx2 and scripts/atx-build.ps1 DEPS ISOLATION). Numbers are citable only on a quiet host with the P-cores leased to one bench at a time.

configurePresets.name: equity-dev
configurePresets.displayName: equity-dev: equity engine and pipeline without optional modules

configurePresets.name: dev-counters
configurePresets.displayName: dev-counters: debug gate with atx-vol algorithm counters
configurePresets.description: Dedicated counters-ON validation lane. Uses its own build-counters directory so a successful default build cannot be mistaken for an instrumented one.

configurePresets.name: dev-shared
configurePresets.displayName: dev-shared: dev + atx libraries as DLLs (smallest artifacts, fastest relinks)
configurePresets.description: Everything in `dev`, plus ATX_SHARED_LIBS=ON: atx-core/tsdb/engine/impl build as DLLs so each test exe links a thin import lib instead of embedding the whole engine — fastest incremental relinks and far smaller per-worktree build dirs (one engine DLL, not ~14 static copies). NEVER THE TEST GATE (validated 2026-07-22): header-inline instrumentation globals (atx/vol/detail/counters.hpp solve ledger etc.) get ONE INSTANCE PER IMAGE on Windows, so the test exe scrapes an empty copy while the DLL increments its own — SolveLedger/BacktestExec observer suites fail deterministically. Use for link-speed iteration on non-instrumentation work; run the gate under `dev` (static). Unity OFF here so a one-file edit relinks just the engine DLL, not a whole unity batch.

configurePresets.name: dev-lakehouse-off
configurePresets.displayName: dev-lakehouse-off: dev + ATX_VOL_LAKEHOUSE=OFF (CI link-check leg, E3)
configurePresets.description: Task E3 CI gate: proves the minimal-install configuration (no research Parquet track store / track_compact CLI) still configures and LINKS cleanly -- track_store.cpp/catalog.cpp/sweep_driver.cpp/track_compact_reconcile.cpp/track_gc.cpp and their tests drop out of the graph entirely (see atx-vol/CMakeLists.txt's ATX_VOL_LAKEHOUSE guard and atx-vol/tests/CMakeLists.txt's matching guard) rather than leaving a dangling undefined-symbol link error. Own binaryDir (build-lakehouse-off/) so this never disturbs the warm ON build in build/ -- D2 verified this leg by temporarily flipping build/'s cache variable and reverting; this preset makes the same leg a standing, non-destructive, re-runnable target instead. Same toolchain/deps as `dev` (ATX_VOL_LAKEHOUSE does not touch compiler flags or third-party deps, so no FETCHCONTENT_BASE_DIR isolation is needed the way rel-avx2 needs one). See atx-vol/ci/lakehouse_off_link_gate.ps1.

configurePresets.name: rel
configurePresets.description: Optimized Release build in build-rel/ for throughput benchmarks and canonical acceptance numbers, on the dev toolchain (clang-cl + compiler cache + shared deps). Never the debug-checked test gate — use `dev` for that. THIN-LTO: CMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION enables clang's -flto=thin across the TU-boundary-heavy solve chain. Turned on at commit 63f6f29 (2026-08-02), whose message carries the evidence: a 2x2 NAV bit-parity matrix {rel, rel-avx2} x {LTO off, on} matching in all four cells (rel 123243.11724603444, rel-avx2 123243.11724602008), all 5 RunArchive section digests identical in every cell, and a 145-test focused group pass/fail/skip-identical LTO-on vs LTO-off ON REL. Read those as dated findings, not as current values: the SSE2 fingerprint 63f6f29 checked (17305682487856730537) has since been re-pinned twice under the P-5/P-R seam, and today is recoverable only with ATX_VOL_DISABLE_IV_EARLY_EXIT=1. The live pins are the kGoldenFingerprintSse2/Fma constants in atx-vol/tests/prepared_portfolio_test.cpp - read them there rather than copying them here, since a copy is precisely what went stale. The test PreparedPortfolio.GroupedPriceEqualsIndependentOracleAndPinnedFingerprint is still the right thing to re-run if you change this setting; only the value it compares against has moved. Scope and rationale: Task 2 of atx-vol/sprints/2026-08-02-atx-vol-v1-production-closeout-sprint.md, itself item 6.3 of atx-vol/sprints/2026-07-26-atx-vol-production-v1-release-sprint.md. `dev`/`hygiene`/`vs` deliberately stay non-LTO: dev's fast-iterate build-time budget and its debug-checked determinism baseline are the point of that preset.

configurePresets.name: rel-avx2
configurePresets.displayName: rel-avx2: Release + global /arch:AVX2 (ISA-fair perf preset, opt-in)
configurePresets.description: ISA-fair perf preset: everything in `rel` (Release, clang-cl, sccache, shared deps) plus global /arch:AVX2 on C and C++ flags, so the compiler can vectorize scalar hot paths and published performance ratios are not understated by the SSE2 default. Opt-in only — the default `rel` preset stays SSE2/portable and is unaffected. Never add /fp:fast here (fast-math is banned repo-wide). Baselines produced under this preset must be named `...-avx2...`. MECHANISM — do not 'simplify' to cacheVariables: /arch:AVX2 is injected via the CFLAGS/CXXFLAGS environment variables, which CMake APPENDS to its platform default flags (/DWIN32 /D_WINDOWS /EHsc) on the first configure of a fresh build dir. Setting CMAKE_C_FLAGS/CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS as preset cacheVariables instead would REPLACE those defaults wholesale, silently dropping /EHsc (exceptions disabled -> spdlog and friends fail to compile). PARALLEL AGENTS / BENCH-LEASE (M6): pass a per-worktree, per-preset -DFETCHCONTENT_BASE_DIR=C:/atx-wt/<wt>/deps/rel-avx2 (new-worktree.ps1 -Isolated wires it) so worktrees never share a spdlog-build object tree; and because this is the perf preset, run benches on a quiet host with the P-cores leased to ONE bench at a time (configure_pricing_executor(PerformanceCores)) and fit fan-out capped via the ATX_VOL_FIT_WORKERS env so a background fit cannot oversubscribe the leased cores.

configurePresets.name: hygiene
configurePresets.displayName: Ninja + clang-cl, PCH OFF (include-hygiene gate, run by hand)
configurePresets.description: Strict build: PCH OFF so every TU compiles with its own includes, catching any missing/unused include the PCH would otherwise mask. Slower (full per-TU header re-parse) — run it by hand before claiming include-clean, not for local iteration. NOTHING RUNS THIS AUTOMATICALLY: the repository's CI is one GitHub Actions workflow, .github/workflows/atx-db.yml (on main and other branches, byte-identical on every ref that carries it; established by sweeping EVERY ref with `git for-each-ref --format='%(refname)'` piped into `git ls-tree -r --name-only` per ref, not a sample - re-run that for the current list). It is path-filtered to atx-db/** and runs ruff/mypy/pytest over Python only - it never invokes CMake or ctest, and no ref carries a nightly job. So if you did not invoke this preset yourself, it did not run.
